MOCK PRODUCT SPEC · HYPOTHETICAL

PRD: Gift Genie

An illustrative PRD for an AI gifting assistant, drawing on my years in personalised gifting. Numbers are hypothetical targets, not real data.

Choosing a personal gift is slow, risky and impersonal

Shoppers browse hundreds of generic catalogue items, are unsure what suits the recipient, and worry whether a personalised item (name, photo, engraving) will look right before it is made. This leads to decision fatigue, abandoned carts and low confidence in custom products.

Pain

"I don't know what they'd like."

Pain

"Will my custom design look good?"

Pain

"Will it arrive in time?"

Goal: Help users go from occasion to a confident, personalised order in under three minutes.

P
Priya, 28
Working professional · Gifter
  • Buys 6–8 gifts a year for family and friends
  • Short on time, wants ideas not catalogues
  • Needs a preview before paying
R
Rahul, 35
Corporate buyer · Bulk gifts
  • Orders branded gifts for teams and clients
  • Needs consistency, budget control and deadlines
  • Wants quick approval of mockups

MVP scope for Gift Genie, prioritised using MoSCoW.

MUST
  • Occasion + recipient + budget questionnaire
  • AI-ranked gift suggestions
  • Live preview of personalisation
SHOULD
  • Delivery-date promise on each result
  • Save and share shortlist
COULD
  • Gift reminders for birthdays
  • AI-written message card
WON'T (for now)
  • Social-media data import
  • Subscription gifting boxes

Hypothetical targets at 90 days after launch.

Time to confident order (< 3 min)80% of sessions
Suggestion-to-cart conversion+15%
Preview-to-order rate+10%
Guardrail: return / complaint rateno increase

FAVORITE PRODUCT CRITIQUE

Spotify, dissected

A personal product teardown. Opinions are mine, not Spotify's data.

What it nails

  • Discover Weekly turns data into a habit loop.
  • Blend and shared playlists make listening social.
  • Seamless cross-device handoff.

Where it falls short

  • Home feed is crowded with music, podcasts and audiobooks.
  • Queue management is clunky for long sessions.
  • Recommendations can feel repetitive for "mood" moments.

Proposed fix: "Mood Dial"

A one-tap slider on Home to tune energy and familiarity ("comfort ↔ explore"), and a simplified queue editor.

Metric: ↑ session length, ↑ saves per session, ↓ skip rate.
